site.sitedescription: Wetland lies within the North Patagonian fold-and-thrust belt in a narrow longitudinal depression on the southwest facing slope of the mountain range. Surface vegetation Scirpus and Empetrum nigrum with Sphagnum magellanicum hummocks in small areas. Stands of Nothofagus antarctica, Pilgerodendron uviferum, and Fitzroya cupressoides occur around the edges. Post-fire stands of Nothofagus dombeyi and Austrocedrus chilensis occur on slopes above and below the wetland.
